_about: AI-assisted: researched and assembled with ChatGPT (OpenAI). See docs/AI_USAGE.md. Draft 2026-09-26. Sources are official Fiscalía, DOJ and Treasury records. Charges are historical allegations; no current whereabouts are inferred. The 21-person 2011 Fiscalía arms/conspiracy sentence list is excluded because individual drug offenses are not established. No photos, precise routes, private locations, or inferred co-defendant ties. Luis Enrique Calle Serna and Pablo Emilio Montoya Osorio are held out pending individually dated drug-case events. Policía Nacional Spanish-language releases add Carlo Hugo García García and Carlos Mario Agudelo Giraldo; Agudelo is described as linked to the organization, not a proven member.
